route_note: Take the Trinity Railway Express (TRE) commuter train from Dallas Union Station or Victory Station directly to Fort Worth's T&P Station or Fort Worth Central, about an hour with no changes.
see: Fort Worth Stockyards and cattle drive

route_note: Take the Trinity Railway Express from Dallas to the Grapevine-Main Street station, then a short walk or local shuttle into the historic downtown; no changes needed on the train.
Take the DCTA A-train from Dallas via a connection at Trinity Mills (DART Green Line) to downtown Denton, or a direct regional bus; the A-train terminates at Downtown Denton station.
